mappingRule: Every inclusive identifier range expands to one entry per FWD identifier; no identifier may occur in two ranges.

groups.disablement: Roles remain NOLOGIN identities; schema and default privileges are removed only by 15A after all package objects prove empty.
Postgres-owned composite constraints and REFERENCES grants are removed only after dependent Offline relations are removed.
Core-owner constraints and REFERENCES grants are reversed under bounded afex_core_owner authority after dependent Offline relations are removed.
15 revokes exact helper EXECUTE; 15A drops the exact postgres-owned private signature after all dependent functions are removed; temporary schema CREATE is restored in-file.
15 removes exact actor_sessions policies and column grants under afex_pos_session_owner without ownership transfer.
15 removes exact postgres-owned support policies and column grants; no Auth object is changed.
Device authority and event relations are removed with RESTRICT only when the complete evidence-row count is zero; otherwise retained as security evidence.
RLS and owner/function-reader policies are relation-bound and disappear only with approved empty relation cleanup.
Browser/runtime table reachability is already revoked; function-owner SELECT exists solely behind SECURITY DEFINER validation.
Revoke provisioning EXECUTE first; retain device/event rows and remove bounded support policies only after all dependent writers are disabled.
Enrollment authority and events are retained when non-empty and otherwise removed with RESTRICT.
RLS and policies are removed only through guarded relation cleanup.
No browser or acquisition-runtime table grant survives forward installation.
Revoke provisioning EXECUTE first; retain enrollment and audit evidence; remove bounded support reads only after dependent bootstrap is disabled.
Key-envelope metadata and its deferred exact-scope FK are retained when non-empty; the reverse FK is removed only inside zero-row cleanup.
RLS and policies are relation-bound and removed only with empty cleanup.
No browser or acquisition-runtime direct table reachability is granted.
Snapshot headers/items are retained as business evidence when non-empty and removed with RESTRICT only at zero rows.
RLS and policies disappear only with guarded empty relation cleanup.
Snapshots remain unreadable to browser and acquisition runtime roles.
Revoke publisher EXECUTE first; immutable snapshots remain retained evidence and inventory_stock remains unmodified.
Bootstrap, roster and logout/recovery events are retained when non-empty; relations are removed only through proven zero-row reverse-DAG cleanup.
Revoke provisioning EXECUTE first; functions may then be dropped by exact signature without deleting pending work.
Indexes, triggers and guard functions are removed only as part of exact reverse-DAG empty-object cleanup; immutable evidence guards are retained with evidence.
Binding rows are retained security evidence; relation removal is permitted only when empty.
Owner, RLS, policies, immutable trigger and guard are relation-bound and removed only by the guarded reverse DAG.
PUBLIC, browser, service and direct acquisition-runtime table privileges are removed or remain absent.
Safe-cast, exact-key and canonicalization helpers are dropped by exact signature with RESTRICT after callers.
Provenance, payment, inventory and semantic validators are dropped by exact signature with RESTRICT.
Runtime grants are first revoked, then one-claim, batch and inventory reader surfaces are dropped by exact signature.
Exact acquisition EXECUTE is revoked first; function is then dropped with RESTRICT.
Exact receipt EXECUTE is revoked first; function is then dropped with RESTRICT. Existing Core receipts and bindings are retained evidence.

functionRemovalDisposition: 15A exact owner-aware drops after zero-row proof
